def: An answer whose claims are all supported by the sources that were supplied to the model for that request.
A pointer from a claim in an answer to the part of a source that is supposed to support it.
How precisely a citation locates its support: whole document, chunk, sentence or exact character span.
The property that a generated statement can be traced to an identified source that supports it.
Whether the answer was actually derived from the cited material, rather than from memory with a citation attached afterwards.
Finding a passage that supports a claim after the fact, so the citation is correct but the model did not use it to produce the claim.
Asking the model to copy relevant verbatim quotes before answering, so every citation can be checked as a substring of the source.
A classification of whether a premise text implies, contradicts or says nothing about a hypothesis claim.
The share of answer sentences that are fully supported by the passages they cite, taken together.
The share of citations that are not irrelevant, where a citation is irrelevant if it does not support the sentence alone and the other citations still do.
Declining to answer, or saying the sources do not contain the answer, instead of producing a plausible guess.
A plot of the share of questions answered against the error rate among those answered, as the abstention threshold varies.
